'''Tatooine repulsor trains''' were used by the [[Pyke Syndicate]] to [[transport]] [[spice]] on [[Tatooine]]. One [[train]] was [[Raid on a Pyke repulsortrain|destroyed]] by [[Boba Fett]] and his adoptive [[Tusken Raider]] [[Unidentified Tusken Raider tribe|tribe]] after the [[Pyke]]s onboard had attacked the tribe on multiple occasions.<ref name="Chapter 2" /> Later, [[Jawa]]s who brought [[Din Djarin]] a [[cryogenic density combustion booster]] said they found it underneath a Pyke train.<ref name="Chapter 5">{{BOBF|Chapter 5: Return of the Mandalorian}}</ref>
